content.user_title: Design Apple Interfaces for Every Platform
content.value_statement: Cross-platform Apple products can feel inconsistent when one interface is reused everywhere. This skill applies platform-specific HIG guidance to navigation, input, layout, accessibility, and implementation planning.
actual_capabilities: Recommends navigation, layout, and input patterns for seven Apple platform contexts.
Compares platform differences in structured tables.
Adapts an existing interface concept to another Apple platform.
Suggests platform APIs and implementation considerations.
Reviews games for display, interaction, accessibility, and platform conventions.
Accounts for device context, supported frameworks, and operating system targets.
limitations: The bundled guidance is a snapshot and may not reflect later Apple updates.
The skill provides design recommendations but does not build or test an application.
API availability and behavior still require verification against current developer documentation.
Accessibility guidance does not replace audits with assistive technologies and representative users.

use_cases.title: Adapt an Existing Product
use_cases.description: Translate an established iPhone workflow into native iPadOS or macOS patterns without losing product intent.

use_cases.title: Plan Platform Architecture
use_cases.description: Map shared features to platform-specific navigation, input methods, APIs, and operating system constraints.

use_cases.title: Review a Multiplatform Experience
use_cases.description: Identify inconsistent interactions, accessibility gaps, and device-specific usability risks before implementation.

prompt_templates.title: Review One Screen
prompt_templates.prompt: Review this [platform] screen for navigation, input, layout, and accessibility: [description]. Return prioritized recommendations with HIG rationale.
prompt_templates.scenario: Beginner review of a single interface

prompt_templates.title: Adapt a Workflow
prompt_templates.prompt: Adapt this existing [source platform] workflow for [target platform]: [workflow]. Compare navigation, input, multitasking, and layout changes in a table.

prompt_templates.title: Plan a Shared Feature
prompt_templates.prompt: Plan [feature] across iOS, watchOS, and visionOS. Define each platform's use context, interaction model, information density, and implementation notes.

prompt_templates.title: Create a Platform Strategy
prompt_templates.prompt: Create a design strategy for [product] targeting [platforms]. Include shared intent, platform-specific architecture, API choices, accessibility risks, and validation criteria.

output_examples.input: Adapt a macOS project browser with a toolbar and inspector for iPadOS.
output: Use a collapsible sidebar for projects and a detail column for the selected item.
Move inspector content into a secondary column or sheet based on available width.
Support touch, pointer, keyboard shortcuts, multitasking, and Stage Manager resizing.

output_examples.input: Review a glanceable fitness status feature for watchOS.
output: Show one primary metric and one immediate action on the main screen.
Use the Digital Crown for vertical inspection of supporting details.
Offer a complication for timely status and reserve notifications for meaningful changes.

output_examples.input: Plan a shared media feature for tvOS and visionOS.
output: tvOS should emphasize focus navigation, large controls, and comfortable viewing across the room.
visionOS should use familiar windows first and add immersion only when it improves the media experience.
Keep content intent shared while adapting input, depth, motion, and comfort requirements.

best_practices: Provide the target platforms, primary use context, supported frameworks, and minimum operating system versions.
Describe the current workflow before requesting a platform adaptation.
Validate recommendations with current Apple documentation, prototypes, accessibility checks, and device testing.
anti_patterns: Do not copy one platform interface unchanged across every Apple device.
Do not ignore each platform's primary input method, viewing distance, or ergonomic constraints.
Do not treat recommendations as proof of technical feasibility or accessibility compliance.

faq.question: Which platforms does this skill cover?
faq.answer: It covers iOS, iPadOS, macOS, tvOS, visionOS, watchOS, and games across Apple devices.

faq.question: Can it generate production code?
faq.answer: It focuses on design recommendations and implementation notes. Generated code still requires engineering, testing, and review.

faq.question: Can it adapt an existing application?
faq.answer: Yes. Provide the source platform, target platforms, current workflow, and constraints for a focused adaptation plan.

faq.question: Does it require network access?
faq.answer: No. The bundled references are local, although they contain links to Apple documentation for optional verification.

faq.question: Will it recommend Apple frameworks and APIs?
faq.answer: Yes. It can suggest relevant options based on platform and framework context, but current availability requires verification.

faq.question: Does it guarantee accessibility compliance?
faq.answer: No. It provides accessibility guidance, but compliance requires assistive technology testing, expert review, and feedback from representative users.
